key_insight: Computation time distributions can distinguish computational mechanisms even when average time scaling appears broadly similar.
engineering_relevance: The framework could support black-box comparison of finite computing systems across physical implementations, though solid-mechanics applications are not demonstrated.
method: Benchmark computation time as problem size increases.
Analyse time distributions as signatures of underlying stochastic dynamics.
Compare human visual search with three evidence-accumulation models.
evidence_signal: In a scalable visual search task, humans and models showed broadly similar time scaling, while distributional analysis distinguished the three models.
watch_item: Validation is limited to visual search; applicability to other tasks and physical computing platforms remains to be established.
paper_title: Distributional signatures of computation: inferring mechanisms from computation time distributions
